description: Claude Code in its own terminal UI, colours, menus and keys as in a terminal: watch and type in the Agents tab. The prompt is pasted once the prompt box shows. The output is the last screen as text: no cost, usage or structured result (use the headless preset for those). The node runs until the program exits, someone ends it, or its timeout. Needs yukta.agents.pty.enabled=true, the command in yukta.process.allowed-commands and HOME in yukta.process.pass-env; log in once beforehand and trust the working folder, else the first screen is a dialog the person answers in the Agents tab before the prompt is typed.
